about: The plan pd_load.py runs through a prefill and a decode server: probe batches, sent one at a time in each scenario while its loads keep the servers busy. A load is clients that each send one request of len prompt tokens and new_tokens output tokens at a time, until the scenario ends; warm_s is how long it runs before the first probe. The pressure scenario needs a decode server started with --max-total-tokens 40000. Written by generate_batches.py, which explains the design.
